name: Random Access CSGV
definition: A compression method for segmentation volumes that allows random access to voxel labels without decoding the entire brick serially, solving the memory overhead and latency issues of CSGV's serial decoding when only few nodes are accessed.
summary: Random Access CSGV is a lossless compression method for segmentation volumes that enables true per-voxel random access in constant time using Huffman-shaped wavelet trees, unlike standard CSGV which requires serial decoding.
